_comment: R6 exhaustion/scoring lane — exhaustion-curve gate thresholds + baselines. UPDATED 2026-08-06: Phase 0 de-saturation ADOPTED, and the terminal_min_gap_pct metric DEMOTED binding->advisory by a UNANIMOUS Pyrrhic ratification panel (game-design + canon/§6 + systems; GO-WITH-CONDITION). Records both the historical FAILING pre-fix curve and the ADOPTED post-fix curve. The two binding engine-health gates (first_saturation_week, dead_weeks_pct) PASS on the adopted engine. terminal_min_gap_pct is advisory (>0), computed+reported but never gated. Metrics 4-5 and any full grade/§6 gating await Phase 3 scoring-reference re-derivation (the real grade pin). CAP = 10000. Evidence: docs/40_reports/20260806_TERMINAL_MIN_GAP_THRESHOLD_EVIDENCE.md; root cause: docs/40_reports/20260806_EXHAUSTION_SATURATION_ROOT_CAUSE.md.

thresholds_binding._note: The TWO binding engine-health gates (once promoted from advisory when Phase 3/4 land). first_saturation_week guards the HEAD (no faction slams the cap early). dead_weeks_pct (KEYSTONE) guards the BODY and TAIL: any week where cross-faction spread < 1% of cap is a dead week, so terminal re-homogenization is caught HERE — this is what enforces the game-design 'no faction reads as equally-spent for a big chunk of the war' intent.

thresholds_advisory._note: ADVISORY — computed + reported (engine_health_gate.cjs measured.exhaustion_curve), NEVER gated. Bar = > 0 (a terminal spread is present). DEMOTED 2026-08-06 from a former binding 5% target by unanimous panel: proven decoupled from every downstream grade/§6 outcome (3.05% and 9.14% both yield all-C, atrocity term inert) — grades are pinned by Phase-3 scoring references, not exhaustion spread. The non-recollapse / non-homogenization guarantee is carried by the BINDING dead_weeks_pct_max, NOT by this metric (panel reconciliation: systems-seat argument resolves the game-design-seat concern). Do NOT re-promote to binding without co-deriving against the Phase-3 scoring references + the exhaustion terminal band.

metrics_4_5_pending._note: cost_index_saturated_components_max (<=1) and war_cost_index_spread (>=0.10) require wiring computeWarCostIndex (src/sim/negotiation/scoring.ts). BLOCKED on Phase 3: the real grade/§6 pin is casualties_full (40000, ~8x too low), duration_full_weeks (156 < 188), exhaustion_full (8000, below the adopted terminal band 8562-9775) — all three saturate the cost index to 1.0 before exhaustion matters. See the threshold-evidence report.

verdict.binding_first_saturation_week: PASS (null >= 150 — the accumulator now approaches but never reaches the cap)
verdict.advisory_terminal_min_gap_pct: ADVISORY-PASS (3.05% > 0). Softness is only the RBiH-HRHB pair (8867 vs 8562); RS clearly separated at 9775. Closing to 5% needs friction fix #2, which regresses combat calibration (matched 634->611 + Bihac §6) — RETIRED; not pursued (calibration-last posture).
verdict.ratification: Pyrrhic panel UNANIMOUS GO-WITH-CONDITION 2026-08-06 — game-design + canon/§6 + systems seats; implementer (scenario-tester) excluded per implementer != reviewer. Conditions applied: (a) terminal_min_gap kept computed+reported as advisory [already true]; (b) threshold-file hygiene — this file now splits binding vs advisory so no future reader silently re-promotes the 5% [done]; (c) advisory bar reduced to '>0', re-collapse enforced by binding dead_weeks [done]; (canon) Phase-3 §6 atrocity-liveness obligation recorded as a HARD gate [see phase3_hard_gate].
verdict.phase3_hard_gate: §6 atrocity-never-rewarded guarantee is RELOCATED (not retired) to Phase 3 as a HARD, owner-visible gate: re-derive casualties_full / duration_full_weeks / exhaustion_full (co-derived with the terminal exhaustion band) so that at full-campaign length war_cost_index is NOT clamped to 1.0 and the atrocity penalty can once again MOVE the grade. No §6 regression vs pre-lane (the term was already inert then). Recorded in MASTER_ROADMAP.md + the exhaustion/scoring redesign plan.
